text: ぼくたち　トレーナーの　バッグは　べんりな　しかけが　ついてるぞ！

structure.jp: ぼくたち　トレーナーの　バッグは
べんりな　しかけが

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says the result is still there. ついてる is the shortened spoken form of ついている = 'is attached, comes with it'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is a rough, mostly male way to push a statement at the listener. ついてるぞ = 'it comes with one, I tell you!'.
